decisions.cardCountBreakdown: 300 base + 50 action + 300 star rubies + 50 action star rubies + five inserts of 15 + 52 autographics + 52 blue-ink autographics = 879
decisions.physicalDistribution: Hobby: 24 packs per box, 8 cards per pack; original MSRP $2.69
decisions.promoExcluded: Ben Grieve promotional sample #83 (TCDB; non-pack-issued) intentionally excluded from pack pools
decisions.numbering: Autographics issued unnumbered; AU01-AU52 are deterministic virtual identifiers based on BaseballCardPedia alphabetical order, not printed card numbers
decisions.rookies: 32 RC-tagged prospects #223-272 cross-checked against BCP and TCDB Rookie Cards; action versions retain RC designation
decisions.unknownOdds: Historical odds for Star Rubies, Star Rubies Action, Intimidation Nation and Autographics Blue Ink are not verified and intentionally left null. These pools will not automatically be assigned invented insertion odds.
decisions.productStructure: One collector-facing 300-card base product set, separate 50-card action variations and 300/50 Star Rubies sets; inserts remain separate complete product sets. All remain unreleased pending card art/pricing/odds review.
